items.text: Congress and the Country salute the outstanding Members of the Select Committee as they exercise oversight authority in continuing to tirelessly pursue the truth of that dark day. Read my full statement on the House amicus brief here: https://t.co/Pad5w8ZxoQ

It is unconscionable and tragic that, right now, families cannot find safe, affordable baby formula to keep their children healthy & growing. Next week, the House will bring up a bill that will empower the federal government to get nutrition into the mouths of America’s babies.

Ensuring that every precious baby has the nutrition that he or she needs is a matter of the baby’s life and development. We must take urgent action to protect their health and well-being – now and for the rest of their lives. Read my Dear Colleague here: https://t.co/0TKg2GcNzR

Join @LeaderHoyer, @RosaDeLauro, @FrankPallone, @RepJahanaHayes, @SenStabenow & me at the U.S. Capitol for a press conference on two new bills to help parents find safe, affordable formula & ensure our babies get the nutrition they need. https://t.co/z9e70tUId2

Yesterday, @HouseDemocrats unveiled a new legislative agenda to ease the unconscionable infant formula shortage.
 
The nutrition babies receive has an immense impact on their entire lives. We must take urgent action to address this emergency. https://t.co/WctkPk6Vnc

Democrats have passed into law action to help babies get the formula they need to be healthy & grow. 

With the Access to Baby Formula Act granting emergency authority to the WIC program, @HouseDemocrats empower the federal government to get nutrition into the mouths of babies.

The @HouseDemocrats are also advancing the Ensuring Women’s Right to Reproductive Freedom Act.
 
This legislation will prevent the GOP from criminalizing, fining or suing women who exercise their Constitutionally protected right to travel across state lines to obtain an abortion.

Thanks to the leadership of @RepBlumenauer, @RepDelBene, @RepDanKildee & @RepJohnLarson, the Formula Act is now the law of the land!

This legislation lowers costs for families, strengthens the supply chain to avoid future shortages & ensures children get the nutrition they need.

Prime Minister Shinzo Abe was an historic leader of Japan, a valued friend to America and a global champion of peace and prosperity.

It was my personal honor to pay tribute to Prime Minister Abe today at the Diet where he served for decades. May he rest in peace. https://t.co/MVJySXX9H2

Our delegation met with @HosodaHiroyuki, Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Japanese Diet.

We discussed our shared democratic values, enhancing inter-parliamentary relationships, and advancing peace and stability in the Indo Pacific. https://t.co/2hf74ZiuJU

Join @RepMcGovern, community leaders and me at the @SFMFoodBank for a roundtable discussion and listening session on the work being done to combat hunger and food insecurity ahead of the @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition and Health. https://t.co/0I0nFXGuER

As @POTUS prepares to host a White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition and Health next month, @HouseDemocrats are committed to seizing this opportunity.

Working together, we will not relent until we secure for our children a future free from the suffering of hunger. https://t.co/BB251jolM2
With the GOP’s utter disdain for our health, safety and freedom, it is only a matter of time that another drug, treatment, vaccine or health service becomes the next target of their extremism.

With this year’s White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition and Health, @POTUS is mobilizing renewed, nationwide action against the hunger crisis – including more than $8 billion in private- and public-sector commitments.

Guided by @RepMcGovern’s leadership of the House Hunger Caucus, we have proudly stood with the grassroots activists working to end hunger once and for all.

@HouseDemocrats will never relent in our fight to build a future free from hunger, food insecurity & diet-related disease.

Join local education and nutrition experts and me at the Florence Fang Community Farm for a roundtable on food sovereignty, where we will discuss how to ensure that communities in the Bayview can grow their own healthy food supply.  https://t.co/Foaacjp80d

Paul is grateful to the 911 operator, emergency responders, trauma care team, ICU staff, and the entire @ZSFGCare medical staff for their excellent and compassionate life-saving treatment he received after the violent assault in our home. https://t.co/nEY8ISANI8

Together, we will continue forging a safer, more just America – one where all of its people can freely and proudly exercise their right to life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. https://t.co/6KZjiOyz8q

For more than a century, Puerto Rico has been governed under a political system imposed by outside forces rather than established by its people. Denied the right to a vote in Congress or for President, Puerto Rico’s territorial status has left it vulnerable to unequal treatment.

Just days after we celebrated the Affordable Care Act’s thirteenth anniversary, North Carolina became the 40th state to join in expanding Medicaid under the ACA!
 
This means that thousands more families will now have affordable, quality health coverage. 
https://t.co/Qg5QZWDJ9Q

Under @POTUS, health care is more affordable than ever. And now, a record 20 million Americans are enrolled in Affordable Care Act coverage.
 
While Trump says Obamacare sucks, Democrats say the ACA cures and we will keep fighting to lower health care costs for all Americans.

Under the magnificent leadership of @POTUS Biden, health care is more accessible and affordable than ever before.

That's why, this year, a record-shattering 21.3 million Americans signed up for health coverage under the Affordable Care Act – five million more than last year.

Join me for a roundtable in San Francisco with patients and providers to mark fourteen years of the Affordable Care Act and its impact on our City.

https://t.co/YVgg6OFA8j

Thanks to the leadership of @POTUS, DACA recipients will now have access to quality health coverage through the Affordable Care Act.
 
Whether teaching or studying in our schools, starting new businesses or serving our nation in uniform, our Dreamers make America more American.

Thanks to the Affordable Care Act, tens of millions of Americans can afford high-quality health care. 

But under the Republican budget plan, the 32,000 people who receive ACA coverage in San Francisco would see their average premium go up by $3,070 per year — a 112% increase.
